thread:
maria_sales: Heads-up - Acme POC is blocked, they get 401 when calling /v1/generate with their service token. @sam_se can you triage? 

sam_se: On it. Can you paste the curl and response? Also which env (poc-acme/test-prod)? 

maria_sales: Here's what they ran (redacted key):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_test_***" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"model":"gpt-small","input":"hello"}'
```
Response:
```
HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
{
  "error": "invalid_api_key",
  "message": "key does not belong to org: org_567"
}
```

acme_engineer: Yep that's exactly it. We generated the key from our account but still getting the org mismatch.

sam_se: OK likely causes:
- token created under a different org/project than the POC project
- using a user token instead of a service token with inference scopes
- missing X-Redwood-Project header when using project-scoped tokens

Can you run `GET /v1/keys/me` with the same token and paste the response (no full key)? That shows which org/project it's tied to.

acme_engineer: Ran it, got back: `{ "id":"key_abc","org":"org_999","scopes": ["read:usage"] }`

sam_se: Aha — scope is wrong and org doesn't match the POC org (org_567 vs org_999). That explains the "does not belong to org" error. Two options:
1) From Console -> Create a new Service Key under the POC project (ensure scopes include `inference:invoke` or `*`) and use that.
2) If you need to reuse key_abc, have your admin reassign or invite the key's org to the POC project (not recommended for POC).

eli_oncall: If you need a quick debug token we can mint a short-lived test token on our side and DM it to you. Will need the POC project id and minimal ACLs. @jen_support please coordinate the ticket so we don't leak keys here. :eyes:

jen_support: Filing a private support ticket now. @acme_engineer please add the POC project id and the command you used. Do NOT paste full keys in the ticket channel, use the secure upload or DM to support.

deploy-bot: New deploy se/poc-env finished at 2025-08-14T14:10:12Z :white_check_mark:

acme_engineer: I created a new service token in the POC project with `inference:invoke` and added header `X-Redwood-Project: proj-poc-456` — it's now returning 200. Thanks!

maria_sales: Amazing — can we capture this flow in the POC runbook so other customers don't hit it? Short note on org vs key vs header.

sam_se: I'll add a snippet to the POC checklist with the curl example and troubleshooting steps. Closing the swarm unless anything else.

acme_engineer: All good from our side. Thanks everyone :trophy:
